generalized_rule: When a text integrity manifest names artifacts below an explicit verifier or output root, the producer must preserve each artifact's path relative to that same portable root, and consumers must resolve relative entries against the manifest directory or another explicit final portable root rather than the process working directory. A basename-only manifest entry is valid only when the artifact is actually colocated with the manifest.
